competencies: Critical Thinking and Problem Solving; Communication and Collaboration; Creativity and Innovation; Personal Development and Leadership; Cultural Identity and Global Citizenship; Digital Literacy
resources: NaCCA CCP approved textbook; TLMs; ICT tools
rpk: Learners can hold conversations, read varied texts and write structured paragraphs; they know songs, folktales, poems and stories from primary school.
starter: Greet learners; 1-minute 'book talk': teacher shows and names a book from the class collection.
Quick recall: learners mention one thing they read last time.
NEW TODAY: Everyone reads a short drama scene quietly.
Set reading rules: eyes on text, quiet lips, note new words.
main: ACTIVITY 1 (Silent reading – 7 min): Learners read a short drama scene individually; teacher listens to 2-3 learners read aloud in turn.
ACTIVITY 2 (Pair read – 5 min): Pairs take turns reading short passages aloud to each other; partners help with hard words.
ACTIVITY 3 (Respond to text – 5 min): Learners answer 3 quick questions: 'What was it about? Who was in it? Which part did you like?'
ACTIVITY 4 (Record – 3 min): Learners write the title and one sentence about a short drama scene in their reading log.
plenary: 2-3 learners share their favourite part with the class.
Teacher displays the reading log and praises consistent readers.
Homework: read one page to a family member and retell it.
Encourage learners to borrow a book for the week.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style assessment

starter: Greet learners; 1-minute 'book talk': teacher shows and names a book from the class collection.

NEW TODAY: Everyone reads an excerpt from a children's novel quietly.

main: ACTIVITY 1 (Silent reading – 7 min): Learners read an excerpt from a children's novel individually; teacher listens to 2-3 learners read aloud in turn.

plenary: 2-3 learners share their favourite part with the class.
Teacher displays the reading log and praises consistent readers.
Homework: read one page to a family member and retell it.
Encourage learners to borrow a book for the week.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style assessment

starter: Greet learners in French ('Bonjour la classe!') and sing a short French greeting song.

ACTIVITY 4 (Performance – 3 min): 2-3 pairs perform the dialogue/answers; class applauds; teacher highlights good French.
plenary: Exit question: every learner says one French word/sentence from today.
Quick game: 'Montrez-moi...' (point to flashcard) for recall.
Homework: teach today's French words to someone at home; write them twice in the exercise book.
Preview next French lesson.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style
